steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Location factors: proximity to customers/market, transport links, availability of suitable labour, cost of premises, competition, government incentives (grants, enterprise zones). | Key Fact: Business plan: a document setting out the business idea, market research, financial forecasts, marketing strategy. Essential for securing finance from banks or investors. Shows the business has thought through its strategy. | Key Fact: Organic growth: expanding from within - opening new outlets, increasing product range, growing online sales. Slow but controlled, less risky than external growth. | Key Fact: External growth: mergers (two firms agree to join) and takeovers (one firm buys another).
